tool.name: Convert images

param.name: input_image
param.label: The input image path.
param.help: The input image path.

param.name: stitch
param.label: Stitch input files with similar names.
param.help: Stitch input files with similar names.

param.name: separate
param.label: Split RGB images into separate channels.
param.help: Split RGB images into separate channels.

param.name: merge
param.label: Combine separate channels into RGB image.
param.help: Combine separate channels into RGB image.

param.name: expand
param.label: Expand indexed color to RGB.
param.help: Expand indexed color to RGB.

param.name: bigtiff
param.label: Force BigTIFF files to be written.
param.help: Force BigTIFF files to be written.

param.name: nobigtiff
param.label: Do not automatically switch to BigTIFF.
param.help: Do not automatically switch to BigTIFF.

param.name: compression
param.label: Specify the codec to use when saving images.
param.help: Specify the codec to use when saving images.

param.name: series
param.label: Specify which image series to convert.
param.help: Specify which image series to convert.

param.name: noflat
param.label: Do not flatten subresolutions.
param.help: Do not flatten subresolutions.

param.name: cache
param.label: Cache the initialized reader.
param.help: Cache the initialized reader.

param.name: --cache-dir
param.label: Use the specified directory to store the cached initialized reader. If unspecified, the cached reader will be stored under the same folder as the image file.
param.help: Use the specified directory to store the cached initialized reader. If unspecified, the cached reader will be stored under the same folder as the image file.

param.name: --no-sas
param.label: Do not preserve the OME-XML StructuredAnnotation elements.
param.help: Do not preserve the OME-XML StructuredAnnotation elements.

param.name: map
param.label: Specify file on disk to which name should be mapped.
param.help: Specify file on disk to which name should be mapped.

param.name: range
param.label: Specify the range of planes to convert. Must be of the form MIN,MAX where MIN is the first plane index and MAX is the last plane index. For example 0,5 will only convert planes 0 to 5. Default will convert every planes.
param.help: Specify the range of planes to convert. Must be of the form MIN,MAX where MIN is the first plane index and MAX is the last plane index. For example 0,5 will only convert planes 0 to 5. Default will convert every planes.

param.name: nogroup
param.label: Force multi-file datasets to be read as individual files.
param.help: Force multi-file datasets to be read as individual files.

param.name: nolookup
param.label: Disable the conversion of lookup tables.
param.help: Disable the conversion of lookup tables.

param.name: autoscale
param.label: Automatically adjust brightness and contrast before converting; this may mean that the original pixel values are not preserved.
param.help: Automatically adjust brightness and contrast before converting; this may mean that the original pixel values are not preserved.

param.name: overwrite
param.label: Always overwrite the output file, if it already exists.
param.help: Always overwrite the output file, if it already exists.

param.name: nooverwrite
param.label: Never overwrite the output file, if it already exists.
param.help: Never overwrite the output file, if it already exists.

param.name: crop
param.label: Crop images before converting. Must be in the form x,y,w,h.
param.help: Crop images before converting. Must be in the form x,y,w,h.

param.name: channel
param.label: Only convert the specified channel (indexed from 0).
param.help: Only convert the specified channel (indexed from 0).

param.name: z
param.label: Only convert the specified Z section (indexed from 0).
param.help: Only convert the specified Z section (indexed from 0).

param.name: timepoint
param.label: Only convert the specified timepoint (indexed from 0).
param.help: Only convert the specified timepoint (indexed from 0).

param.name: padded
param.label: Filename indexes for series, z, c and t will be zero padded.
param.help: Filename indexes for series, z, c and t will be zero padded.

param.name: novalid
param.label: Will not validate the OME-XML for the output file.
param.help: Will not validate the OME-XML for the output file.

param.name: validate
param.label: Will validate the generated OME-XML for the output file.
param.help: Will validate the generated OME-XML for the output file.

param.name: tilex
param.label: Image will be converted one tile at a time using the given tile width.
param.help: Image will be converted one tile at a time using the given tile width.

param.name: tiley
param.label: Image will be converted one tile at a time using the given tile height.
param.help: Image will be converted one tile at a time using the given tile height.

param.name: --pyramid-scale
param.label: Generates a pyramid image with each subsequent resolution level divided by scale.
param.help: Generates a pyramid image with each subsequent resolution level divided by scale.

param.name: --pyramid-resolutions
param.label: Generates a pyramid image with the given number of resolution levels.
param.help: Generates a pyramid image with the given number of resolution levels.

tool.help: Convert image file formats. The extension of the output file specifies the file format to use for the conversion. For example, to convert the input image to png and keep the input name, use "{input_image.stem}.png"
